text: ポケモンは　１ぴきだけ　つよくても　にがてな　タイプには　かてない　たくさん　そだてる　ほうが　いいよ

structure.jp: ポケモンは　１ぴきだけ　つよくても
structure.en: even if just one Pokémon is strong

structure.jp: にがてな　タイプには　かてない
structure.en: it can't beat types it's weak against

structure.jp: たくさん　そだてる　ほうが　いいよ

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: ても on the end means 'even if'. What follows is true anyway. つよくても = 'even if it is strong'.

patterns.name: 〜ほうがいい
patterns.span: そだてる　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by ほうがいい gives advice: doing that is the better choice. そだてる　ほうが　いい = 'it's better to raise them'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる turns 'win' into 'can win'; ない makes it 'cannot'. かてない = 'can't win'.
